from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentClassificationData(BaseModel):
    """Extracted classification features from a single document."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as written")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The broad nature of the case, e.g. 'Administrative Litigation', 'Civil Litigation', 'Execution Review'")
    administrative_departments: list[str] | None = Field(description="Names of government bodies involved, e.g. 'Civil Affairs Bureau', 'Housing and Urban-Rural Development Commission'")
    commercial_entities: list[str] | None = Field(description="Names of companies or commercial entities involved in the dispute")
    dispute_subject: str | None = Field(description="The core subject matter or dispute type, e.g. 'Information Disclosure', 'Administrative Agreement', 'Equity Transfer', 'Execution Objection'")
    procedural_stage: str | None = Field(description="The procedural stage mentioned, e.g. 'Second Instance', 'Retrial', 'Execution Review'")
    parties: list[str] | None = Field(description="Names of all litigating parties mentioned")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentClassificationData]
